pages.text: Random and unstable Ages often grow skins no sane world should wear: hex plates, wire cells, separators, cables, fractal cubes, light fissures, and creeping virus growths. These are not ornaments. They are the Age showing its bones.

A landmark written by name feels less like an intrusion and more like a promise. Chance may still add wonders of its own, but an Age already rich with chosen features is less eager to improvise further. Dense ores, greedy things, follow their own habit.
$(item)Lost Pages$() reveal symbols by old fortune. Humble tools appear often. Fiercer signs, such as cities, biospheres, dense ores, and $(thing)Age Effect$(), hide like gemstones in river silt.
